title: IBM Storage TS4500 Library 1.1.1.6 through 1.12.0.3 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to perform…
description: IBM Storage TS4500 Library versions 1.1.1.6 through 1.12.0.3 contain an authorization vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to perform unauthorized account takeover. This flaw arises from improper authorization checks within the affected versions.
